title: A two-term locally finite free resolution of an integral local system
statement: Let ℓ be prime, E a finite normed extension of Q_ℓ, X a scheme with noetherian underlying space, and P a locally finitely presented module over the ordinary integral condensed coefficient ring on X. There exist modules F1 and F0, maps f:F1→F0 and g:F0→P with f g=0, such that 0→F1→F0→P→0 is short exact, and each Fi becomes a finite free module on a pro-etale covering of X. The covers of F1 and F0 may differ. Torsion in P is allowed. These are existential witnesses used in proofs, not data defining a library object.

proof.text: Use the eventual free-image theorem to choose N, a=ℓ^N id_P, I=image(a), Q=cokernel(a), and the actual canonical generator epimorphism b:B(Q)→Q. Both I and B(Q) are locally finite free.

Let q:P→Q be the cokernel map and form F0=P×_Q B(Q). Its projection to B(Q) is an epimorphism with kernel canonically image(a), using Abelian.imageIsoImage and the kernel comparison for pullbacks. Locally split this short exact sequence over finite free charts of B(Q); the middle term is locally finite free by its biproduct isomorphism.

The projection g:F0→P is epimorphic. The existing integral matrix-kernel and lfp-kernel arguments make K=kernel(g) locally finitely presented. Rationalization of P is locally finite free by the field theorem. On a common cover choose a finite free epimorphism A→K and compose with K→F0 to obtain δ:A→F0, whose image is K and whose cokernel is P.

Prove image(δ) locally finite free by induction on the rank of A using the integral pivot cover. A zero map has zero image. In the nonzero block ((p,rp),(c,d)), the pivot p is monic and rationally invertible. An explicit unipotent source automorphism factors the block epimorphically onto R⊕image(d-r c), then monomorphically into its target, so its image is that biproduct. The Schur complement has the same rational cokernel and smaller source rank. Transport images and free bases through the coefficient pullback isomorphisms.

Take F1=kernel(g), f=kernel.ι(g), and w=kernel.condition(g). ShortComplex.exact_kernel and the epimorphism g give the required short exact sequence. The preceding proofs supply the two locally finite free covers. No data definition chooses existential witnesses.
